exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.angle: 45° Bench • Arms Hang Behind Torso
exercises.rom: Full elbow extension at bottom to 125° curl without lifting elbows forward
cues: Set bench to 45° and pin shoulder blades back against the pad.
Keep elbows pointing straight down behind your torso the entire rep.
Supinate pinky upward at the top and lower for a full 3-second stretch.
exercises.avoid: Swinging elbows forward shifts tension off the long head onto the front delt.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (EZ-Bar or DB)
exercises.angle: 45° Pad • Arms In Front of Torso
exercises.rom: Near-full stretch (avoid hyperextension) to 110° peak squeeze
cues: Armpits snug over the top edge of the preacher pad.
Control the bottom 20% slowly—that is where short-head tension peaks.
Stop slightly before vertical at the top so tension stays on the bicep.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing out of the bottom or shrugging shoulders up off the pad.

exercises.name: Cross-Body / Standing Hammer Curl
exercises.angle: 0° Neutral Wrist (Palms Facing In)
exercises.rom: Dead hang at side to upper-chest level with locked upper arm
cues: Keep thumbs pointing up (neutral grip) to bias the brachialis and brachioradialis.
Glue elbows to your ribs—zero torso sway.
Squeeze hard for 1 second at the top to thicken outer arm width.
exercises.avoid: Rotating wrists palm-up midway turns it back into a standard curl.

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.angle: Cable Low • Step Forward 25° Shoulder Extension
exercises.rom: Arm pulled behind hip into deep stretch, curl toward shoulder
cues: Face away from a low pulley so the cable pulls your arm backward.
Keep elbow stationary behind your hip line throughout.
Constant cable tension hits the long head even at full extension.
exercises.avoid: Letting the cable yank your shoulder into internal rotation at the bottom.

exercises.name: Seated Concentration Curl
exercises.angle: Elbow Braced Inside Inner Thigh
exercises.rom: Full arm hang to peak supinated squeeze toward opposite shoulder
cues: Brace back of triceps firmly against inner thigh to eliminate cheating.
Twist pinky inward at peak contraction for maximum bicep cramp.
Control the eccentric all the way down.
exercises.avoid: Using your leg to push the elbow upward on tough reps.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.angle: Overhand Pronated Grip • Wrists Flat
exercises.rom: Full hang to 90–110° elbow flexion keeping wrists neutral
cues: Use a pronated (palms-down) grip to maximize brachioradialis and brachialis.
Keep knuckles stacked straight—don't curl wrists backward.
Pushes the biceps up from underneath for thicker arms.
exercises.avoid: Dropping wrists into extension or using too much weight with back swing.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
exercises.angle: Arms Overhead 150–170° • Torso Forward 20°
exercises.rom: Deep elbow bend behind head to full lockout overhead
cues: Raise arms overhead to put the tricep long head on maximum stretch.
Let forearms fold deep behind your head before pressing out.
Keep elbows pointing roughly forward—don't flare wide.
exercises.avoid: Dropping elbows down toward your ribs turns it into a chest/press.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown (Bar or Rope)
exercises.angle: Elbows Pinned at Sides • Slight 10° Forward Lean
exercises.rom: Forearms parallel/high (120° bend) down to full crisp lockout
cues: Pin upper arms tightly to your ribs—only the forearm pivots.
Lock elbows fully at the bottom and hold for 1 second.
With a straight/V-bar you can overload lateral head; with rope spread slightly at bottom.
exercises.avoid: Letting elbows drift forward and using shoulders/lats to press down.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.angle: Shoulder-Width Grip • Elbows Tucked 20°
exercises.rom: Lower bar to lower sternum/xiphoid, drive straight to lockout
cues: Grip shoulder-width (not touching hands—too narrow hurts wrists).
Tuck elbows closer to ribs than flat bench so triceps carry the load.
Pause lightly on lower chest and press explosively.
exercises.avoid: Hands touching together—it stresses wrists without extra tricep gain.

exercises.name: Incline EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
exercises.angle: 30° Incline Bench • Arms Angled 15° Back
exercises.rom: Lower bar behind top of head for deep stretch, extend back to start
cues: Angle upper arms slightly back behind vertical so tension never drops at the top.
Lower behind the crown of your head rather than to your forehead.
Keep elbows narrow and stable.
exercises.avoid: Vertical arms over the chest let gravity disappear at lockout.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Reverse Cable Pushdown
exercises.angle: Underhand Supinated Grip • Elbow Tight
exercises.rom: Full elbow bend above parallel down to complete straight-arm lockout
cues: Use a D-handle with palm facing up to emphasize the medial head near the elbow.
Keep wrist straight and elbow pinned against your side.
Squeeze hard at full lockout for elbow-end tricep density.
exercises.avoid: Twisting torso or flaring elbow outward.

exercises.name: 30° Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.angle: 30° Bench Incline • Elbows 45° Tucked
exercises.rom: Deep stretch beside upper chest to full converge overhead
cues: Use 30° incline (45° shifts too much load to front delts).
Tuck elbows 45° from torso—never flared straight out at 90°.
Touch dumbbells gently near upper chest level, pause 1s, press up and slightly inward.
exercises.avoid: Setting bench at 45–60° or flaring elbows out, which steals upper-chest work with shoulders.

exercises.name: Flat Barbell / Machine Chest Press
exercises.angle: 0° Flat Bench • Mild Arch • Elbows 45–60°
exercises.rom: Touch mid-lower sternum with control, drive smoothly to lockout
cues: Retract and depress shoulder blades into the bench before unracking.
Lower bar to nipple/lower-sternum line with forearms vertical.
Drive feet into floor for stability without bouncing bar off ribs.
exercises.avoid: Flaring elbows 90° toward your ears—hard on shoulders and weakens pec drive.

exercises.name: Forward-Lean Chest Dip
exercises.angle: 30° Torso Forward Lean • Legs Slightly Back
exercises.rom: Shoulders below elbows (90°+ stretch) to near-lockout squeeze
cues: Lean torso forward ~30° and flare elbows slightly to bias lower chest over triceps.
Descend until bicep touches forearm or upper arm is slightly below parallel.
Keep shoulders pushed down away from ears at the top.
exercises.avoid: Staying completely upright turns dips into a tricep exercise instead of lower chest.

exercises.name: Seated / Standing Cable Fly (High-to-Low & Mid)
exercises.angle: 15° Soft Elbow Bend • Arms Sweeping Across Chest
exercises.rom: Wide pec stretch in line with torso to hands meeting in front of sternum
cues: Think about bringing your biceps/elbows together, not your hands.
Keep a fixed 15° bend in your elbows—don't turn it into a press.
Set pulleys slightly above shoulders for lower/mid sweep, or low-to-high for upper chest.
exercises.avoid: Letting shoulders roll forward at the end of the squeeze.

exercises.name: Pec Deck / Machine Chest Fly
exercises.angle: Seat Height = Handles Align With Mid Chest
exercises.rom: Full stretch just past torso plane to strong 1s squeeze in front
cues: Adjust seat so arms are slightly below shoulder height.
Keep chest proud and shoulder blades pinned to backrest.
Pause 1 second in the fully contracted position.
exercises.avoid: Setting seat too low so handles sit at chin level (overworks front delts).

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
exercises.angle: Pulleys at Hip Level • Scoop Upward 45°
exercises.rom: Arms wide and low to palms meeting at upper-chest / chin level
cues: Follow the upward-inward fiber direction of the clavicular (upper) chest.
Keep palms facing forward/up and scoop arms up to collarbone height.
Squeeze upper chest hard for 1s at the top.
exercises.avoid: Bending elbows and turning it into a front raise.

exercises.name: Wide / Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.angle: 10–15° Slight Lean Back • Grip 1.3× Shoulder Width
exercises.rom: Full overhead lat stretch (ribs lifted) to bar touching upper collarbone
cues: Initiate by depressing shoulders down, then drive elbows toward your hips.
Let arms stretch completely overhead between reps so lats lengthen.
Avoid leaning back 45°—stay tall to keep pull vertical for lat width.
exercises.avoid: Pulling with biceps and leaning way back turns it into a row.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Machine / DB Row
exercises.angle: 30–45° Chest Pad • Elbows 45–60° Out
exercises.rom: Full protraction (shoulder blades spread forward) to tight squeeze back
cues: Chest stays glued to pad—zero lower-back or glute fatigue!
Let shoulder blades wrap forward at the bottom for a deep mid-back stretch.
Drive elbows back and squeeze shoulder blades together for 1 second.
exercises.avoid: Pulling torso off the pad with momentum.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Iliac Lat Row / Pulldown
exercises.angle: Elbow Tight to Ribcage • Pull Toward Hip
exercises.rom: Full forward reach across midline to elbow stopping right at hip
cues: Keep elbow tucked close to your ribs and pull in an arc toward your pocket.
Stop elbow right at torso plane—pulling further back shifts work to rear delt.
Allow shoulder blade to glide forward smoothly on every rep.
exercises.avoid: Pulling elbow way behind your back or shrugging shoulder up.

exercises.name: Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.angle: Shoulder-Width+ Overhand Grip • Chest Proud
exercises.rom: Dead hang (ears between biceps) up to collarbone near bar
cues: Pull chest toward the bar rather than craning your chin over it.
Full dead hang at bottom stretches the lats completely.
Use assisted machine or band if needed to hit clean 6–10 reps.
exercises.avoid: Half-reps from 90° elbows miss the best lat-growth stretch.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pullover
exercises.angle: 35° Hip Hinge • Arms Nearly Straight (15° Bend)
exercises.rom: Arms overhead in line with torso down to thighs—zero bicep involvement
cues: Takes biceps completely out of the equation so you truly feel your lats.
Hinge hips slightly back and sweep hands down toward your pockets.
Pause 1s at your thighs with lats flared.
exercises.avoid: Bending elbows into a tricep pushdown.

exercises.name: Kelso / Incline Trap Shrug
exercises.angle: 15° Slight Forward Lean • Pull Up & Slightly Back
exercises.rom: Full downward shoulder depression to peak ear-ward shrug pause
cues: Lean 10–15° forward so trap fibers line up directly with gravity.
Hold the top squeeze for 2 full seconds instead of bouncing.
Let dumbbells pull shoulders all the way down between reps.
exercises.avoid: Rolling shoulders in circles—move cleanly up-and-back along fiber angle.

exercises.name: 45° Back Extension (Spinal Bias)
exercises.angle: 45° Roman Chair • Pad Below Hip Crease
exercises.rom: Controlled torso fold down to parallel with floor—squeeze erectors up
cues: Set pad high enough to stabilize pelvis, fold smoothly at waist/hips.
Stop at neutral straight line at top—do not hyperextend past flat.
Hold a light plate against chest once bodyweight is easy.
exercises.avoid: Jerking upward past straight spine alignment.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.angle: 75–80° High Incline • Elbows 30° Forward (Scapular Plane)
exercises.rom: Dumbbells to ear/chin level to full controlled overhead press
cues: Set bench one notch below 90° (around 75–80°) for safer shoulder mechanics.
Keep elbows angled 30° forward of your torso, never flared straight back.
Brace abs so lower back doesn't arch off the pad.
exercises.avoid: Flaring elbows straight out at 90°—pinches the shoulder joint.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise (Wrist-Height)
exercises.angle: Pulley at Wrist Height • Arm 30° Forward
exercises.rom: Hand across thigh up to shoulder height—constant tension from start
cues: Setting the pulley at wrist height gives peak tension at the bottom where side delts grow most!
Reach outward toward the wall, not upward toward your ears.
Stop at shoulder height so upper traps don't take over.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging shoulders up or swinging torso to heave heavy weight.

exercises.name: Leaning / Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.angle: 10° Forward Lean • Thumbs Level
exercises.rom: Arms beside hips raised slightly forward (30° scapular plane) to shoulder level
cues: Raise dumbbells slightly in front of your hips (30° angle), not dead-sideways.
Keep pinkies level with thumbs—don't pour the pitcher aggressively.
Lead with the elbows and control the lowering for 2 seconds.
exercises.avoid: Turning thumbs steeply downward causes shoulder impingement.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck / Rear Delt Fly
exercises.angle: Neutral/Palms-In Grip • Chest Braced on Pad
exercises.rom: Arms sweeping outward in 30–45° arc just to torso line (not pinching traps)
cues: Push handles outward toward the side walls rather than squeezing shoulder blades together.
Stopping just in line with your torso keeps tension purely on rear delts.
Keep traps relaxed and neck long.
exercises.avoid: Pinching shoulder blades hard shifts work from rear delts to rhomboids/mid-traps.

exercises.name: Rope Face Pull (External Rotation)
exercises.angle: Pulley at Face Height • Split Stance
exercises.rom: Full forward protraction back to double-bicep pose beside ears
cues: Grip rope with thumbs pointing backward so hands lead past ears.
Finish in a double-bicep pose—wrists behind elbows.
Great for shoulder health, posture, and rear-delt cap.
exercises.avoid: Pulling toward the chest with elbows low turns it into a row.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extension (Zero Glute)
exercises.angle: Backrest Reclined 100–110° • Knee Aligned With Pivot
exercises.rom: Maximum knee bend (100°+) up to crisp full lockout pause
cues: Reclining the seat slightly stretches the rectus femoris (middle quad) much better!
Align your knee joint directly with the machine's red/yellow pivot axis.
0% glute involvement—pure quad growth and teardrop (VMO) detail.
exercises.avoid: Lifting hips off the seat on heavy reps or stopping short of lockout.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Feet Low & Narrow — Quad Focus)
exercises.angle: Feet Low on Platform • Shoulder-Width • Knees Forward
exercises.rom: Hamstrings cover calves (deep knee flexion) back to 95% lockout
cues: Placing feet LOWER on the sled maximizes knee bend (Quads) and keeps Glutes minimal (~15%).
Let knees travel smoothly forward over toes while keeping heels glued down.
Brace back flat against pad the whole rep.
exercises.avoid: Putting feet high up on the platform shifts focus straight into glutes!

exercises.name: Heels-Elevated Goblet / Smith Squat
exercises.angle: Heels Elevated on Plates • Upright Torso
exercises.rom: Straight-down upright knee travel to full depth without leaning forward
cues: Raise heels 1–2 inches on small plates and stay vertical to isolate quads over glutes.
Push knees forward rather than sitting hips far back.
Great quad-sweep builder if your gym lacks a Hack Squat.
exercises.avoid: Folding torso forward turns it into a hip/glute squat.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.angle: High-Bar Position • Feet Shoulder-Width
exercises.rom: Crease of hip below top of knee to strong upright standing lockout
cues: Note: High glute involvement (~42%). Use Low-Glute Mode if you want pure quad focus!
Big belly brace before descending; track knees directly over 2nd/3rd toe.
Drive evenly through mid-foot.
exercises.avoid: Good-morning squat (hips shooting up faster than chest).

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Zero Glute)
exercises.angle: Hips Flexed 90° • Lap Pad Locked Tight
exercises.rom: Full straight-leg stretch at top down to ankle under seat
cues: Outperforms lying leg curl because flexed hips put hamstrings on a deeper stretch!
Zero glute growth—100% isolated hamstring shape from behind.
Lean slightly forward over the lap pad for an even stronger stretch.
exercises.avoid: Letting thighs lift off the seat during heavy curls.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Zero Glute)
exercises.angle: Hips Pressed Flat Into Bench
exercises.rom: Near-straight legs curled smoothly until pad touches hamstrings
cues: Drive hips down into the pad—do NOT let your butt pop up as you curl!
Hits the lower/distal hamstring peak strongly.
Control the lowering phase for 2–3 seconds.
exercises.avoid: Arching lower back and lifting hips up off the bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell / Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.angle: 15° Fixed Soft Knee • Pure Hip Hinge
exercises.rom: Push hips straight back until bar reaches mid-shin, stand to neutral
cues: Note: Hits hamstrings AND ~38% glutes. Stop right at mid-shin to bias hamstrings; going lower brings in more glutes.
Keep bar/dumbbells shaving your thighs and shins.
Stand tall to neutral—don't thrust hips hard forward at the top unless training glutes.
exercises.avoid: Bending knees more mid-rep turns it into a squat/glute lift.

exercises.name: Barbell / Machine Hip Thrust
exercises.angle: Shoulder Blades on Bench • Shins Vertical at Top
exercises.rom: Hips drop 45° down, drive up to horizontal tabletop with 1s lock
cues: Only select this if you WANT dedicated glute growth (~90% glute load).
Keep chin tucked forward and ribs down—avoid overarching lower back.
Shins should be perpendicular (90°) to the floor at peak lockout.
exercises.avoid: Feet too close hits quads; feet too far shifts to hamstrings.

exercises.name: Cable / Machine Hip Abduction
exercises.angle: Upright Torso • Drive Knees Outward
exercises.rom: Knees together to maximum lateral hip abduction pause
cues: Targets upper/side glute shelf (gluteus medius).
Keep pelvis steady and control the return.
Skip this if you're trying to minimize glute size.
exercises.avoid: Using momentum or rocking torso back and forth.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.angle: Upright = Quad Bias • 25° Lean = High Glute
exercises.rom: Back knee hovers 1 inch off floor, drive through front foot
cues: High Glute alert (~55% if leaning forward)! Keep torso upright and stance shorter to shift onto quads.
70–80% of body weight stays on the front leg.
Pause 1s near the floor for stability.
exercises.avoid: Taking a very long step + leaning torso forward makes this mostly a glute builder.

exercises.name: Standing / Leg-Press Calf Raise
exercises.angle: Knees Straight (Locked Soft) • Balls of Feet on Edge
exercises.rom: Full 2-second deep heel-drop stretch up onto big-toe peak
cues: Straight knees are mandatory to load the gastrocnemius (diamond calf muscle).
ALWAYS pause 2 seconds at the bottom stretch—never bounce off your Achilles tendon!
Drive straight through the ball of your big toe.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing fast at the bottom lets elastic tendon recoil do the work instead of muscle.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.angle: Knees Bent 90° • Pad Above Knees
exercises.rom: Deep ankle dorsiflexion stretch to full heel lift pause
cues: Bending the knee 90° relaxes the gastrocnemius so the deeper soleus takes over for lower-leg thickness.
Hold the bottom stretch 2 seconds every single rep.
Smooth, strict ankle range—zero bouncing.
exercises.avoid: Fast half-reps that never hit full stretch.

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Rope Crunch
exercises.angle: Hips Locked Stationary • Curl Ribs to Pelvis
exercises.rom: Ribcage extended upright curling spine down into tight C-shape
cues: Freeze your hips—do NOT sit your butt back toward your heels!
Think about rolling your ribs toward your belly button like a spinal curl.
Exhale completely at the bottom squeeze.
exercises.avoid: Hinging back and forth at the hips uses hip flexors, not abs.

exercises.name: Hanging / Captain's Chair Leg Raise
exercises.angle: Posterior Pelvic Tilt • Curl Tailbone Up
exercises.rom: Dead hang legs raised past 90° by curling pelvis toward chest
cues: Raising legs to 90° is mostly hip flexors—the magic for lower abs happens when you curl your pelvis upward past 90°!
Bend knees slightly if needed so you can curl your tailbone up cleanly.
Lower slowly without swinging.
exercises.avoid: Swinging legs with momentum and stopping at 90°.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof / Diagonal Woodchopper
exercises.angle: Arms Extended • Rotate Through Ribcage
exercises.rom: Controlled rotation from pulley side across chest to opposite hip
cues: Keep arms relatively straight and pivot through your mid-torso/obliques.
Avoid twisting lower back aggressively—brace abs tight.
Control the return back to the cable stack.
exercises.avoid: Pulling with arms/shoulders instead of rotating through the waist.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Spider Curl
exercises.angle: 45° Bench Prone • Arms Hang Vertically
exercises.rom: Full hang perpendicular to floor up to max peak squeeze
cues: Lie chest-down on a 45° incline bench so arms hang straight down.
Zero momentum possible—pure peak contraction on the short head.
Squeeze hard for 1s at the top of every rep.
exercises.avoid: Pulling elbows backward toward hips during the curl.

exercises.name: Pendlay / Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.angle: 45° Torso Angle • Overhand Shoulder-Width Grip
exercises.rom: Full arm hang near shins pulled explosively to lower ribs/belly
cues: Lock torso at ~45°—don't stand upright with each rep.
Pull toward belly button for lats; higher toward chest for upper/mid back.
Keep lower back neutral and braced.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing upright with legs and hips to heave the bar.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Wide/Neutral Attachment)
exercises.angle: Torso Upright 90° • Slight Knee Bend
exercises.rom: Full forward shoulder stretch to handle touching lower sternum
cues: Zero glute fatigue; sit tall and let shoulder blades protract forward between reps.
Wide neutral-grip targets mid-back & rear delts; narrow close-grip biases lats.
Pause 1s with chest proud at the pull.
exercises.avoid: Rocking torso wildly back and forth like a rowing machine.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Double-Bicep Curl
exercises.angle: Arms Raised 90° Sideways • High Pulleys
exercises.rom: Arms straight out at shoulder level curled toward ears
cues: Raises elbows in front/side plane to isolate the bicep short head peak.
Keep upper arms parallel to the floor—only bend at the elbow.
Great finisher for pump without joint stress.
exercises.avoid: Dropping elbows downward as you fatigue.
